Die übrigen 5 Bataillons der Brigade, nebst 2 Esquadrons neumärkischer Dragoner, und 2 Esquadrons vom 4ten kurmärkischen Landwehr-Kavallerie-Regiment bezogen zwischen Marvilles und der Festung einen Bivouak

claims.value: Plotho assigns the local investment to Krafft and Bork under the broader Prince August command. At exit he calls the French commandant Colonel Foras; Bodart calls the commander Plaige, with no succession resolved here.
claims.rationale: Terminal name difference unresolved, not silently reconciled as succession or alias. English rendering (ours): "Krafft ordered the investment; on July twenty-third the French garrison left under commandant Colonel Foras."

claims.value: Bodart’s frozen June 24–July 20 interval remains. Plotho places the request to capitulate on July 21 and garrison exit on July 23; Vaudoncourt also lists July 23.
claims.rationale: Capitulation/exit milestones differ from frozen endpoint; no hidden cohort/date change. English rendering (ours): "Plotho: on July twenty-first the garrison asked to capitulate; on July twenty-third it left. Vaudoncourt lists Landrecies on the twenty-third."

citations.quote: Am 21sten Juli des Morgens um 5 Uhr waren die Arbeiten auf beiden Ufern ziemlich vollendet. Nach 9 Uhr fingen die preußischen Batterien zu spielen an, und nachdem sie nur kurze Zeit gefeuert hatten, schlug die Garnison Chamade und verlangte zu kapituliren.
